title: Shape-Aware Three-Way Merge for RDF Knowledge Graphs: The schema defines the conflict: an implementation and evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Merging RDF serializations creates ordering conflicts and misses semantic ones. We describe and evaluate a three-way merge in which the schema defines a conflict: set algebra combines canonical triples, and a slot is contended only where a SHACL shape bounds its cardinality and both sides' changes cannot stand within that bound. Unbounded predicates union; contended slots go to a person. The same shapes graph validates the result. We do not claim the first three-way merge for RDF. Our contribution is an implementation in a production multi-agent store and an evaluation against a reimplementation of Quit Store's Context Merge overlap rule, which it extends rather than replaces, and six other strategies. Across five synthetic seeds, the shape-aware operator raised 33 conflicts, all true positives as judged by the same shapes that define them, with no triples lost or fabricated and no SHACL violations admitted. translated_title: 面向RDF知识图谱的形状感知三方合并：由模式定义冲突的实现与评估
translated_abstract: 合并RDF序列化会产生顺序冲突并遗漏语义冲突。我们描述并评估了一种由模式定义冲突的三方合并方法：使用集合代数合并规范化三元组，仅当SHACL形状约束了某个槽位的基数、且双方的修改无法在该约束范围内共存时，该槽位才被视为有争议。无基数限制的谓词取并集；有争议的槽位则交由人工处理。同一形状图可用于验证合并结果。我们并不声称这是首个针对RDF的三方合并。我们的贡献是在生产级多智能体存储中的具体实现，以及对Quit Store的Context Merge重叠规则（我们对其进行了扩展而非替代）的重新实现和另外六种策略的评估。在五个合成种子数据集上，形状感知算子提出了33个冲突，经定义这些冲突的相同形状判定全部为真阳性，且没有三元组丢失或伪造，也未引入任何SHACL违规。上下文重叠基线……
tldr: 本文提出一种由SHACL形状定义冲突的RDF知识图谱三方合并方法，在生产级多智能体存储中实现并评估，结果表明其提出的33个冲突全部为真阳性，且不丢失、不伪造三元组、不引入SHACL违规。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a three-way merge for RDF knowledge graphs in which SHACL shapes define conflicts, implemented in a production multi-agent store, whose evaluation shows all 33 raised conflicts are true positives with no triples lost, fabricated, or SHACL violations admitted.
